skill_name: Summarize an article about the latest fitness trends
workflow: The fitness trends of 2021 are focusing on making workouts enjoyable and convenient while keeping people safe and healthy. HIIT, Pilates, and yoga classes are becoming popular options, as well as home workouts with online classes. Health tracking has become more personalized with smartwatches, with people increasingly tracking steps, sleep, and heart rate.
